long_description_md:
## What it does

The canonical MiroShark-on-Aeon automation repo from Aaron (creator of both [Aeon](https://github.com/aaronjmars/aeon) and [MiroShark](https://github.com/aaronjmars/MiroShark)). A broad, actively-maintained collection of Aeon agent skills that automate work around the MiroShark engine.

## Why

MiroShark is Aaron's universal swarm-intelligence engine. This repo is where the public Aeon automation for it lives — the hub the rest of the MiroShark-on-Aeon ecosystem orbits.

Indexed on Sparkleware so the MiroShark Aeon skills are discoverable alongside the rest of the registry.
